notes: Eightfold requires an account before applying. Create it once, then reuse the saved browser profile.
Account creation flow: Create an account, marketing-consent gate (leave unchecked), email, Continue, Create Password, password, Submit, 6-digit email code.
TrustArc cookie overlay intercepts clicks. Remove the overlay nodes, do not just click accept.
Elements of a step stay in the DOM after the app moves past them, so every presence check must test visibility.
The privacy gate button is labelled "Agree & Continue". It can appear twice, before and after Apply.
Applying goes through Career Hub profile creation first: Agree & Continue, then Upload a resume, then Continue.
Getting to the form is a fixed five-move opening: Agree & Continue, pick the Resume card, Continue, upload, Continue.
The file input does NOT exist until after the first Continue. Uploading earlier silently does nothing.
After upload you land in a 6-step 'Build your profile' wizard with clean ids: firstname, lastname, phone, location, gender.

jobs._removed: Per-company answers are personal and live in the private repo.
